finding_titles: BACKEND_UPSTREAM had no testable representation or validation contract
Origin forwarding did not cover REST, auth, Socket.IO, reconnect, and absent Origin
Optional public readiness had no selected disposition
Public route exclusions and SPA fallback lacked a deterministic matrix
Reviewed wording could imply a forbidden per-Issue code review

rounds.report: The revised ticket locks upstream validation, present and absent Origin behavior across REST, auth, and Socket.IO, omitted public readiness, deterministic route and SPA precedence, and the single whole-K6 review policy. The revision remains inside ADR-016 and exposes no D2-only value.
